```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(fpp3)
library(nortest)
library(gridExtra)
```
------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Load & Clean Data
```{r, warning = F, message = F}
file <- "data/monthly_in_situ_co2_mlo.dat"
data_raw <- read_table(file, skip = 64, col_names = FALSE)
names(data_raw) <- c("Year", "Month", "Date1", "Date2", "CO2", "seasonally_adjusted", 
                     "fit", "seasonally_adjusted_fit", "CO2_filled", 
                     "seasonally_adjusted_filled", "Station")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# CO2 to Temperature Anomaly
```{r}
S = 2.37 # Climate sensitivity factor
initial_anomaly = 0.07 + 0.19 # Baseline temperature anomaly
CO2_contribution = 0.7

data_table <- data_raw %>% 
  filter(Year > 1958 & Year < 2020) %>%
  select(Month, CO2_filled) %>%
  mutate(Time = row_number(),
         c0 = lag(CO2_filled, n = 1),
         delta_CO2 = CO2_filled - c0,
         delta_Temp = S*log2((c0+delta_CO2)/c0),
         Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly = initial_anomaly + cumsum(replace_na(delta_Temp,0)),
  )
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Summary of Climate Data (check)
```{r}
observed_anomaly = 1.11 + 0.19
forecasted_anomaly = tail(data_table$Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly,1)
anomaly_difference = observed_anomaly - forecasted_anomaly

forecasted_warming = sum(data_table$delta_Temp,na.rm=TRUE)
actual_warming = observed_anomaly - initial_anomaly
warming_difference = actual_warming - forecasted_warming

# Print all key data points in one single block
cat("\n---------------- Climate Model Forecast vs. Observed Data ----------------\n",
    sprintf(" %-40s : % .7f °C\n", "Observed Anomaly (Observed, Dec 2019)", observed_anomaly),
    sprintf(" %-40s : % .7f °C\n", "Forecasted Anomaly (CO2-Only, 100%)", forecasted_anomaly),
    sprintf(" %-40s : % .7f °C\n", "Anomaly Difference", anomaly_difference), "\n",
    
    sprintf(" %-40s : % .7f °C\n", "Forecasted Warming (CO2-Only)", forecasted_warming),
    sprintf(" %-40s : % .7f °C\n", "Actual Warming (Observed)", actual_warming),
    sprintf(" %-40s : % .7f °C\n", "Warming Difference", warming_difference), "\n"
)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Convert to Time Series
```{r}
data_table_ts <- tsibble(Month_index = yearmonth(seq(as.Date("1959-01-15"), 
                                                     as.Date("2019-12-15"), 
                                                     by = "1 month")),
                         Time = data_table$Time, 
                         Month = data_table$Month,
                         CO2 = data_table$CO2_filled,
                         index = Month_index)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Plot CO2 and Temperature Anomaly 
```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
data_table_original <- tsibble(Month_index = yearmonth(seq(as.Date("1959-01-15"), 
                                                           as.Date("2019-12-15"), 
                                                           by = "1 month")),
                         Time = data_table$Time, 
                         Month = data_table$Month,
                         CO2 = data_table$CO2_filled,
                         c0 = data_table$c0,
                         delta_CO2 = data_table$delta_CO2,
                         delta_Temp =  data_table$delta_Temp,
                         Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly =  data_table$Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly,
                         index = Month_index)

#Convert month in data_table_ts from a number to a factor for color coding purposes
data_table_ts$Month <- as.factor(data_table_ts$Month)
head(data_table_ts)
#Plot CO2 vs. Time
co2_plot <- data_table_ts %>% autoplot(CO2) +
  geom_point(aes(y=CO2, color=Month), size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "blue", "purple", "red", "orange", "darkred", "green", "chartreuse4", 
                                "chocolate", "gray60", "gold4", "salmon")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  ggtitle("CO2 vs. Time") + xlab("Time") + ylab("CO2")
co2_plot
#Plot temp anomaly vs. Time
temp_plot <- data_table_original %>% autoplot(Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly) +
  geom_point(aes(y=Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly, color=Month),size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "blue", "purple", "red", "orange", "darkred", "green", "chartreuse4", 
                                "chocolate", "gray60", "gold4", "salmon")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  ggtitle("Temp Anomaly vs. Time") + xlab("Time") + ylab("Temp Anomaly") +
  
  # Add Paris Agreement reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +  # 1.5°C Best Effort Limit
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +  # 2.0°C Warming Limit
  
  # Add Labels for Paris Agreement Limits with more space
  annotate("text", x = min(data_table$Time), y = 1.55, label = "1.5°C Best Effort", color = "red", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = min(data_table$Time), y = 2.05, label = "2.0°C Warming Limit", color = "red", hjust = 0, size = 4)
temp_plot
# Combine both plots in a single figure

```

#Stationarity Check
```{r}
data_table_ts %>% ACF(CO2) %>% autoplot()
unitroot_kpss(data_table_ts$CO2)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# STL Decomposition + ARIMA + SARIM
```{r}
result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA <- data_table_ts %>%
  model(decomposition_model(
    STL(CO2 ~ season(window=23)),
    ARIMA(season_adjust ~ pdq() + PDQ(0,0,0),  
          stepwise=FALSE, approximation=FALSE, trace=FALSE), 
    ARIMA(season_year ~ 0 + pdq(0,0,0) + PDQ(0,1,0))
  ))

report(result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA)
```
------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Residuals Analysis
```{r}
result_ARIMA_augment <- augment(result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA)
result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA %>% augment() %>% ACF(.resid) %>% autoplot()
result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA %>% gg_tsresiduals()
ad.test(result_ARIMA_augment$.resid)

# add forecasts to data_table_ts
data_table_ts$residuals <- result_ARIMA_augment$.resid #one step ahead in-sample forecast errors
data_table_ts$forecasts <- result_ARIMA_augment$.fitted #one step ahead in-sample forecast of Y
tail(data_table_ts)
```
------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Forecast Future CO2 Levels until Present
```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
months_until_today <- 72 
forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_today <- result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA %>% 
  forecast(h=months_until_today, point_forecast=list(.median=median))

forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_today %>% autoplot(data_table_ts) +
  geom_line(aes(y = result_ARIMA_augment$.fitted), color = "red", lty = 2) +
  ggtitle("CO2 Forecast (Black: Observed, Red: Forecasted)") + 
  xlab("Time") + ylab("CO2")
```

# Forecast Future CO2 Levels 20 Years (definition of climate)
```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}

forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate <- result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA %>% 
  forecast(h=months_climate, point_forecast=list(.median=median))

forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate %>% autoplot(data_table_ts) +
  geom_line(aes(y = result_ARIMA_augment$.fitted), color = "red", lty = 2) +

  xlab("Time") + ylab("CO2")
```

# Forecast and Print Temperature Anomalies for "Until Present," "20-year Climate Window," and "Zoomed in"
```{r,fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
# Forecast temperature anomalies for 20 year climate window

starting_anomaly_end_of_historical = 1.17 + 0.19 #from GISS NASA

months_climate <- 240 #until is 2/15/2039
forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate <- result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA %>% 
  forecast(h=months_climate, point_forecast=list(.median=median))

#forecast 95% confidence intervals for temperature anomaly

forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate <- forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate %>% hilo(95) %>% select(-.model) %>%
  unpack_hilo("95%") %>%
  rename(CO2_lower = `95%_lower`, CO2_upper = `95%_upper`, CO2_median = .median)


forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate <- forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate %>%
  mutate(
    Time = row_number(),
    c0 = lag(CO2_median, n = 1),
    delta_CO2 = CO2_median - c0,
    delta_Temp = S*log2((c0+delta_CO2)/c0),
    Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly = starting_anomaly_end_of_historical + cumsum(replace_na(delta_Temp,0)),
    
    # Lower 95% bound
    c0_lower = lag(CO2_lower, n = 1),
    delta_CO2_lower = CO2_lower - c0_lower,
    delta_Temp_lower = S * log2((c0_lower + delta_CO2_lower) / c0_lower),
    Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower = starting_anomaly_end_of_historical + cumsum(replace_na(delta_Temp_lower, 0)),

    # Upper 95% bound
    c0_upper = lag(CO2_upper, n = 1),
    delta_CO2_upper = CO2_upper - c0_upper,
    delta_Temp_upper = S * log2((c0_upper + delta_CO2_upper) / c0_upper),
    Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper = starting_anomaly_end_of_historical + cumsum(replace_na(delta_Temp_upper, 0))
  )

tail(forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate)


#Fix Time variable to start at 733 not 1
# Find the last historical time value
last_historical_time <- max(data_table_original$Time, na.rm = TRUE)
last_historical_time

# Fix the Time column in forecasted data by continuing from the last historical time
forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate <- forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate %>%
  mutate(Time = last_historical_time + row_number())

# Verify the fix
head(forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate$Time)

# Merge historical and forecasted data
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  data_table_original %>% 
    mutate(Source = "Historical"),
  
  forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate %>% 
    mutate(Source = "Forecast")
)

# Ensure Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly exists
if (!"Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly" %in% colnames(combined_data)) {
  stop("Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly not found in combined_data. Check dataset.")
}

# Create the Temperature Anomaly plot using autoplot
merged_temp_plot <- autoplot(combined_data, Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly) +

  # 95% Confidence Interval as a shaded region
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower, 
                  ymax = Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper), 
              fill = "gray", alpha = 0.4) +
  
  # Paris Agreement Reference Lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +  
  
  # Labels for Paris Agreement Limits
  annotate("text", x = min(combined_data$Time, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1.55, label = "1.5°C Best Effort", 
           color = "red", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = min(combined_data$Time, na.rm = TRUE), y = 2.05, label = "2.0°C Warming Limit", 
           color = "red", hjust = 0, size = 4) +

  # Titles and Labels
  ggtitle("Global 1-Climate Ahead (20 Year) Temperature Anomaly Forecast (In-Sample & Forecast) with 95% Confidence Interval") + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  ylab("Temperature Anomaly (°C)") +

  # Theme Customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))

# Display the plot
print(merged_temp_plot)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Create Blended Average to smooth transition from historical to forecasted period
```{r,fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
# Create a new table to avoid modifying previous data
blend_years <- 5  # Transition period in years
blend_months <- blend_years * 12
transition_index <- max(data_table_original$Time, na.rm = TRUE) # Last historical data index

# Generate blending weights
blending_weights <- tibble(
  Time = (transition_index + 1):(transition_index + blend_months),
  weight = seq(0, 1, length.out = blend_months)
)

# Create a new blended forecast table
forecast_blended_temp <- forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate %>%
  left_join(blending_weights, by = "Time") %>%
  mutate(weight = replace_na(weight, 1)) %>%  # Ensure weights default to 1 for post-transition period
  mutate(
    
    #Blended median forecast
    Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly = case_when(
      Time <= transition_index + blend_months ~ 
        (1 - weight) * tail(data_table_original$Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly, 1) + 
        weight * Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly,
      TRUE ~ Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly
    ),
    
    # Blended Lower 95% bound
    Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower = case_when(
      Time <= transition_index + blend_months ~ 
        (1 - weight) * tail(data_table_original$Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly, 1) + 
        weight * Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower,
      TRUE ~ Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower
    ),

    # Blended Upper 95% bound
    Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper = case_when(
      Time <= transition_index + blend_months ~ 
        (1 - weight) * tail(data_table_original$Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly, 1) + 
        weight * Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper,
      TRUE ~ Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper
    )
    
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly)  # Ensure no NA values remain

# Merge historical and blended forecasted data into a new table
combined_blended_data <- bind_rows(
  data_table_original %>% mutate(Source = "Historical"),
  forecast_blended_temp %>% mutate(Source = "Forecast")
)

# Ensure the blended variable exists
if (!"Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly" %in% colnames(combined_blended_data)) {
  stop("Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly not found in combined_blended_data. Check dataset.")
}

# Create the blended plot
blended_temp_plot <- ggplot(combined_blended_data, aes(x = Month_index, y = Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly)) +
  
  # Confidence Interval (Shaded Region)
  geom_ribbon(data = combined_blended_data %>% filter(Source == "Forecast"),
              aes(ymin = Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower, 
                  ymax = Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper), 
              fill = "gray", alpha = 0.4) +
  
  # Historical Temperature Anomaly
  geom_line(data = combined_blended_data %>% filter(Source == "Historical"),
            aes(y = Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Blended Temperature Forecast
  geom_line(data = combined_blended_data %>% filter(Source == "Forecast"),
            aes(y = Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Paris Agreement Reference Lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +  
  
  # Labels for Paris Agreement Limits
  annotate("text", x = min(combined_blended_data$Time, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1.55, label = "1.5°C Best Effort", 
           color = "red", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = min(combined_blended_data$Time, na.rm = TRUE), y = 2.05, label = "2.0°C Warming Limit", 
           color = "red", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  
  # Titles and Labels
  ggtitle("Blended 1-Climate Ahead Global Temperature Anomaly Forecast (In-Sample & Forecast) with 95% Confidence Interval") + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  ylab("Temperature Anomaly (°C)") +
  
  # Theme Customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))

# Display the blended plot
print(blended_temp_plot)


```

# Visualize/Forecast Breach of Warning Limit

```{r,fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
# Use same blending variables & weights tibble as before


# Create a new blended forecast table
forecast_blended_temp2 <- forecast_result_dcmp_ARIMA_SARIMA_climate2 %>%
  left_join(blending_weights, by = "Time") %>%
  mutate(weight = replace_na(weight, 1)) %>%  # Ensure weights default to 1 for post-transition period
  mutate(
    Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly = case_when(
      Time <= transition_index + blend_months ~ 
        (1 - weight) * tail(data_table_original$Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly, 1) + 
        weight * Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly,
      TRUE ~ Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly
    ),
    # Blended Lower 95% bound
    Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower = case_when(
      Time <= transition_index + blend_months ~ 
        (1 - weight) * tail(data_table_original$Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly, 1) + 
        weight * Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower,
      TRUE ~ Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower
    ),
    # Blended Upper 95% bound
    Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper = case_when(
      Time <= transition_index + blend_months ~ 
        (1 - weight) * tail(data_table_original$Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly, 1) + 
        weight * Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper,
      TRUE ~ Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly)  # Ensure no NA values remain

# Merge historical and blended forecasted data into a new table
combined_blended_data2 <- bind_rows(
  data_table_original %>% mutate(Source = "Historical"),
  forecast_blended_temp2 %>% mutate(Source = "Forecast")
)

# Ensure the blended variable exists
if (!"Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly" %in% colnames(combined_blended_data2)) {
  stop("Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly not found in combined_blended_data2. Check dataset.")
}

# Create the blended plot
blended_temp_plot2 <- ggplot(combined_blended_data2, aes(x = Month_index, y = Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly)) +
  
  # Confidence Interval (Shaded Region)
  geom_ribbon(data = combined_blended_data2 %>% filter(Source == "Forecast"),
              aes(ymin = Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Lower, 
                  ymax = Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly_Upper), 
              fill = "gray", alpha = 0.4) +
  
  # Historical Temperature Anomaly
  geom_line(data = combined_blended_data2 %>% filter(Source == "Historical"),
            aes(y = Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly), color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Blended Temperature Forecast
  geom_line(data = combined_blended_data2 %>% filter(Source == "Forecast"),
            aes(y = Blended_Forecasted_Avg_Global_Temp_Anomaly), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  
  # Paris Agreement Reference Lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +  
  
  # Labels for Paris Agreement Limits
  annotate("text", x = min(combined_blended_data2$Time, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1.55, label = "1.5°C Best Effort", 
           color = "red", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  annotate("text", x = min(combined_blended_data2$Time, na.rm = TRUE), y = 2.05, label = "2.0°C Warming Limit", 
           color = "red", hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  
  # Titles and Labels
  ggtitle("Blended Global Temperature Anomaly Forecast (In-Sample & Forecast)") + 
  xlab("Time") + 
  ylab("Temperature Anomaly (°C)") +
  
  # Theme Customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))

# Display the blended plot
print(blended_temp_plot2)


```
